study_title: Employer Training Investment Capacity: A Longitudinal UK Study
design: Repeated cross-sectional secondary analysis of official UK employer training statistics
source_name: UK Employer Skills Survey 2024 - Investment in Training
license_note: Explore Education Statistics publishes downloadable government open data; reuse is subject to the publisher's Open Government Licence terms and release guidance.
comparability_note: 2019 is intentionally excluded from the UK-wide longitudinal series because Scotland did not participate in ESS 2019.
inflation_note: Historical expenditure comparisons use the source-provided 2024-price variables. The repository does not independently re-inflate earlier years.
methodology_note: The 2024 Investment in Training follow-up collected expenditure information from 6,210 sites; 275 incomplete cases were excluded, leaving 5,935 sites for analysis. Published expenditure estimates use survey weighting and documented modelling of missing expenditure components.
coverage_measure_note: training_coverage_share is a repository-derived trainees/employees ratio from published aggregate counts. Because the counts are survey-weighted and may be rounded, it is an approximate descriptive reach measure rather than a separate official percentage estimate.
construct_boundary: Observed expenditure intensity and training reach are aggregate L&D resource-deployment indicators, not direct measurements of training quality, learning transfer, skill gain, causal return on investment, worker-level outcomes, or latent organizational capability.
